frequency_question: How often do threatened major trade tariffs reach implementation on schedule within the window without being dropped or superseded by a deal?
membership_rule: Includes official public announcements of sweeping tariffs with a set implementation date within 3 months; excludes minor antidumping duties or non-trade sanctions.
window: 60 to 90 days from announcement to implementation date

cases.name: U.S.-Europe Steel and Aluminum Tariffs Implementation (2018)

coverage_note: 5 named major escalation threats in recent decades matching the temporal and structural profile; believed complete for major executive tariff threats under similar compressed timelines.
validity_reason: Executive trade policy mechanisms and negotiation dynamics remain stable across presidential administrations over this multi-year horizon.
